account_people_revocation_check.name: account_people_revocation_check
account_people_revocation_check.value: ("account_people"."status" = 'active' and "account_people"."revoked_at" is null) or ("account_people"."status" = 'revoked' and "account_people"."revoked_at" is not null)

assistant_runs_usage_check.name: assistant_runs_usage_check
assistant_runs_usage_check.value: ("assistant_runs"."usage_input_tokens" is null or "assistant_runs"."usage_input_tokens" >= 0) and ("assistant_runs"."usage_output_tokens" is null or "assistant_runs"."usage_output_tokens" >= 0)

assistant_runs_audio_metrics_check.name: assistant_runs_audio_metrics_check
assistant_runs_audio_metrics_check.value: ("assistant_runs"."audio_duration_ms" is null or "assistant_runs"."audio_duration_ms" > 0) and ("assistant_runs"."audio_size_bytes" is null or "assistant_runs"."audio_size_bytes" > 0)

opening_message.name: opening_message
opening_message.default: 'Olá! Tudo bem? Gostaria de conversar com você.'

channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions_wi.name: channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions_window_check
channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions_wi.value: ("channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."assistant_enabled" and (("channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."start_time" is null and "channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."end_time" is null) or ("channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."start_time" is not null and "channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."end_time" is not null and (("channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."end_day_offset" is null and "channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."start_time" < "channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."end_time") or ("channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."end_day_offset" between 0 and 6 and ("channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."end_day_offset" > 0 or "channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."start_time" < "channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."end_time")))))) or (not "channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."assistant_enabled" and "channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."start_time" is null and "channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."end_time" is null and ("channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."end_day_offset" is null or "channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."end_day_offset" between 0 and 6))

channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions_ti.name: channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions_time_format_check
channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions_ti.value: ("channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."start_time" is null or "channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."start_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$') and ("channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."end_time" is null or "channel_assistant_schedule_exceptions"."end_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')

lead_contacts_outreach_review_check.name: lead_contacts_outreach_review_check
lead_contacts_outreach_review_check.value: ("lead_contacts"."outreach_decision" = 'pending' and "lead_contacts"."outreach_basis" is null and "lead_contacts"."outreach_evidence" is null and "lead_contacts"."outreach_reviewed_at" is null) or ("lead_contacts"."outreach_decision" <> 'pending' and "lead_contacts"."outreach_basis" is not null and "lead_contacts"."outreach_evidence" is not null and "lead_contacts"."outreach_reviewed_at" is not null)

lead_qualification_facts_value_check.name: lead_qualification_facts_value_check
lead_qualification_facts_value_check.value: ("lead_qualification_facts"."state" in ('unknown', 'not_applicable') and "lead_qualification_facts"."value" is null) or ("lead_qualification_facts"."state" not in ('unknown', 'not_applicable') and "lead_qualification_facts"."value" is not null and length(trim("lead_qualification_facts"."value")) between 1 and 2000)

lead_qualification_facts_source_check.name: lead_qualification_facts_source_check
lead_qualification_facts_source_check.value: ("lead_qualification_facts"."source" = 'conversation' and "lead_qualification_facts"."source_message_id" is not null) or ("lead_qualification_facts"."source" <> 'conversation' and "lead_qualification_facts"."source_message_id" is null)

opportunities_custom_stage_check.name: opportunities_custom_stage_check
opportunities_custom_stage_check.value: ("opportunities"."stage" = 'custom' and "opportunities"."pipeline_stage_key" is not null) or ("opportunities"."stage" <> 'custom' and "opportunities"."pipeline_stage_key" is null)

opportunity_stage_history_from_custom_st.name: opportunity_stage_history_from_custom_stage_check
opportunity_stage_history_from_custom_st.value: ("opportunity_stage_history"."from_stage" is null and "opportunity_stage_history"."from_pipeline_stage_key" is null) or ("opportunity_stage_history"."from_stage" = 'custom' and "opportunity_stage_history"."from_pipeline_stage_key" is not null) or ("opportunity_stage_history"."from_stage" is not null and "opportunity_stage_history"."from_stage" <> 'custom' and "opportunity_stage_history"."from_pipeline_stage_key" is null)

opportunity_stage_history_to_custom_stag.name: opportunity_stage_history_to_custom_stage_check
opportunity_stage_history_to_custom_stag.value: ("opportunity_stage_history"."to_stage" = 'custom' and "opportunity_stage_history"."to_pipeline_stage_key" is not null) or ("opportunity_stage_history"."to_stage" <> 'custom' and "opportunity_stage_history"."to_pipeline_stage_key" is null)

pipeline_stages_name_check.name: pipeline_stages_name_check
pipeline_stages_name_check.value: "pipeline_stages"."is_system" or ("pipeline_stages"."name" is not null and length(trim("pipeline_stages"."name")) between 2 and 64)
